Changes are coming to F1’s rain tyres. 🌧️ Pirelli is preparing revised intermediate and full wet tyres for 2027, with quicker warm-up for the intermediates a key focus. Drivers raised concerns over grip and tyre temperatures in Brazil. The new specifications are due to be homologated in December. Source: The Race

🚨 Daily Mail journalist Jonathan McEvoy has had his F1 media accreditation withdrawn for the rest of 2026 after calling Charles Leclerc a “sneaky little bastard” in a column, according to The Telegraph. The FIA said the article fell short of the professional standards expected of accredited media.

Meeting some of the Palestinian children evacuated from Gaza and supported by inaraorg in Egypt broke my heart. Beautiful, bright children who have faced trauma, grief and horrendous injuries, things no child should ever have to endure. Some have been shot or badly burned in attacks and are still facing a complicated road towards recovery. But what really struck me was how resilient they were and how much joy they seem to find in each other. I also know how hard it is for talented young drivers to get that first opportunity, especially when budgets are tight. Yes, this is real. 🐎 Suzuka’s iconic 130R will be renamed “Umamusume 130R” from 20 November for approximately one year, after Cygames secured the corner’s naming rights. Umamusume: Pretty Derby is also becoming the first founding partner of the 2027 Japanese Grand Prix.

Nessa segunda o café da manhã foi mais do que especial! ☕🏎️ Tive o prazer de visitar a Ana Maria Braga no Mais Você, na TV Globo, para um bate-papo sobre minha trajetória e os desafios das pistas. E a Porto também esteve comigo nesse momento, reforçando uma mensagem muito importante: assim como nas pistas, na vida é fundamental estar preparado e protegido para imprevistos. Falamos sobre a importância do seguro auto e como ter a tranquilidade de contar com quem cuida de você faz toda a diferença. Obrigado pelo carinho, Ana Maria e equipe do Mais Você! Foi demais! 💙
